Name: Simple Sprinkler Upgrade 2
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]💧 Simple Sprinkler Upgrade 2[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.4.0+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Extend your sprinklers’ reach, spot gaps before planting, and reuse older sprinklers as you upgrade.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]💧 Adjustable Watering Range[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Basic, Quality and Iridium Sprinklers each have a separate [b]+0 to +3 extra-radius[/b] setting, defaulting to [b]+1[/b]. At the defaults, without a Pressure Nozzle, they water [b]8, 24 and 48 surrounding tiles[/b] respectively.

Set a tier to zero for its original pattern. Pressure Nozzles add their normal bonus. Custom sprinkler types do not receive these tier bonuses.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🌱 Coverage and Water Now[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The coverage guide marks [color=#67E8F9]covered tiles[/color], [color=#FDE68A]overlaps[/color] and [color=#FCA5A5]uncovered tilled soil[/color]. Holding a sprinkler also shows the placement preview; pointing at one shows its radius and covered crop count.

Use [b]Action[/b] beside a placed sprinkler with empty hands or a tool selected to choose [b]Water now[/b], toggle coverage or set that sprinkler’s individual bonus. Individual bonuses cannot exceed the tier’s configured limit. Water now follows normal sprinkler restrictions.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🔧 Upgrade Existing Sprinklers[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Quality Sprinkler upgrade[/b]
1 Basic Sprinkler + 1 Gold Bar + 1 Refined Quartz

[b]Iridium Sprinkler upgrade[/b]
1 Quality Sprinkler + 1 Iridium Bar + 1 Battery Pack

Each recipe unlocks after learning the matching original sprinkler recipe. Existing saves receive eligible recipes on load. The new recipes create ordinary sprinklers; the original recipes remain available.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]⚙ Settings and Multiplayer[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.[/b] Adjust tier bonuses or turn coverage, details, Water now and individual ranges on or off. The coverage shortcut starts unassigned. Without GMCM, edit config.json while the game is closed. Includes all twelve game languages.

In multiplayer, use the same version on participating computers. The host controls gameplay settings; players control their own coverage displays. Other sprinkler-range or interaction mods may overlap.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Install or Update[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b]. Extract [b]SimpleSprinklersUpgrade2[/b] into Mods and launch through SMAPI. Replace the previous installation, keep config.json, and keep only one copy, including any old SprinklerPlusOne folder.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a report or suggestion on this mod's page.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]For bug reports, please include:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]• Mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform.
• What happened, what you expected and steps to reproduce it.
• A [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], if applicable.
• A screenshot or short video, if helpful.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]For suggestions:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]Tell me what you would like added or changed and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
